title: MLOPS↔QA-001: Pipeline Validation + Drift-Trigger Verification
description: MLOps provides pipeline test hooks, staging deployments for validation, and enforced validation gates; QA returns validation test results, deployment-dry-run validation, and drift-trigger verification. Grounded in MLOPS_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.6. (QA §6 has no MLOps subsection; this edge is grounded from the MLOps side.) Drift-trigger verification addresses erosion-shaped failure (FMEA FC-022 closed-loop drift).

drift_trigger_verification.description: Verification that drift triggers fire correctly (erosion-shaped detection).

drift_metric.description: Monitored drift metric (e.g., accuracy delta vs. baseline, PSI).

trigger_threshold.description: Threshold that should fire a retrain/alert.

trigger_fires_correctly.description: Verified that the trigger fires at the threshold (no silent erosion).

x-macp.tier_rationale: Pipeline validation gates feed the release-gate sign-off and the QA go/no-go. Drift-trigger verification guards the closed-loop retraining path (FC-022) — a silently-eroding monitor is a Critical-chain risk.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (gate definition at planning; validation during execution; release-gate sign-off)
confirm_conditions: pipeline_validation_surface exposes ≥1 test_hook and ≥1 validation_gate (with unit + blocking)
a PASS validation_result includes a completed drift_trigger_verification
reject_conditions: validation_result = PASS without drift-trigger verification (erosion blind spot — FC-022)
trigger_fires_correctly = false declared release-ready (silent drift accepted — Prime Directive §10.1)
a drift threshold emitted without a unit
counter_conditions: drift baseline itself may be re-baselined on contaminated data — request longitudinal baseline provenance (FC-022)
staging environment unavailable for dry-run — request provisioning before sign-off
